newsitem.title: USA: Offshore drillers rally on Global earnings.
newsitem.headline: Offshore drillers rally on Global earnings.

text.p: Shares of offshore drilling companies rallied Monday after Global Marine Inc reported sharply higher first quarter earnings that exceeded analysts' estimates.

"Demand for rigs offshore in West Africa and the Gulf of Mexico is pushing the sector, and there are new markets opening in Latin America," said Bernard Slutsky, analyst at Howard Weil in New Orleans.
Global added 5/8 to 20-1/4 on volume of 881,000 shares. The company reported first quarter earnings of $0.29 a share, up from $0.09 a year earlier and above analysts' forecasts of $0.25.
Diamond Offshore rose two points to 67-3/4, and Transocean Offshore added 1-1/4 to 61-5/8. Cliffs Drilling was up 2-5/8 to 63-7/8, and ENSCO International advanced 5/8 to 46-3/4.
"The industry is also stronger on the back of better oil prices and the fact that the sector suffered last week," said Yves Siegel, analyst at Smith Barney.
The sector was stronger in a generally weaker market.
"Even if the wider market turns sour, this sector should outperform because it has a superior earnings outlook. There is room for more upward earnings revisions," said Siegel.
